basic_info.description: **Fixer-Upper Opportunity in Excelsior District**  Discover the potential in this two-level single-family home. A true diamond-in-the-rough. The main level offers 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a living room, and a formal dining area. The lower level includes an additional 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, providing flexibility for extended relatives, guests, or a home office. Enjoy a spacious, level backyard perfect for gardening, outdoor entertaining, or playtime. The attached garage with interior access offers tandem parking for two cars.  Ideally located near shopping, diverse dining options, and public transportation. Don't miss this opportunity.
